request.spec:
Let me tuck away clients I no longer work with. They should drop off my list and my search.
I do not want to lose them. Note it when I do.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Let me tuck away clients I no longer work with. They should drop off my list and my search.
I do not want to lose them. Note it when I do.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The test passes. Let me verify I didn't leave the `clients-empty` edge case broken — when all clients are archived, `clients.length` still counts... actually no, `load()` fetches only non-archived clients now, so `clients` only holds visible ones. The empty-state check works correctly.

The change is complete and verified. Summary of the full-stack change:

- **Migration** `V17__clients_archived.sql` — adds `archived BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE` to `clients`, so existing/new clients stay visible and archived ones are retained (never lost).
- **Server**
  - `Client.java` — new `archived` field with getter/setter.
  - `ClientRepository.findByArchivedFalse()` — returns only clients still in play.
  - `ListClients` — now returns non-archived clients, so archived ones drop off the list *and* the search (which filters that same list).
  - `ArchiveClient` + `clients/{id}/archive.POST.yml` — new additive endpoint that flags the client archived, keeps the row, and records `CLIENT_ARCHIVED id=<id>` via the `Audit` service.
- **Front-end** `clients/feature.tsx` — an `Archive` button (`client-archive-<id>`) on each row that POSTs to the archive endpoint and reloads; the archived client vanishes from list and search.

All matches the spec's anchors (`client-archive-1`, `client-row-1`) and audit line (`CLIENT_ARCHIVED id=1`).
